info.title: How is &ha; achieved for &hana; and &sap; applications?

abstract.para: Learn about &ha; for &hana; and other &sap; applications included in &sles4sap;.

topic.para:
&suse; &ha; for the &hana; database is based on HANA system replication. Several HANA scenarios are supported.
The &ha; solution includes resource agents, HA/DR provider hook scripts, and tools for specific cluster administration tasks. The solution can be installed through the sles_sap_HADB pattern.

&ha; for &s4h; central services is based on the &sap; Enqueue Standalone Architecture 2 (ENSA2).
The solution integrates HA cluster and &sap; basic administration framework through the sap-suse-cluster-connector package. This integration greatly simplifies cluster administration tasks. The solution can be installed through the sles_sap_HAAPP pattern.
